jobs.description:
Job Location (Short): Houston, Texas\-USA \| Madison, Alabama\-USA \| New York \- Home Office, New York\-USA
Workplace Type: Remote
Req Id: 3348
**Responsibilities**
--------------------


The Graph Engineer owns the Octave platform's knowledge graph — the canonical, cross\-product representation of industrial intelligence that powers every agent, model, and application built on the platform. This role sits at the intersection of knowledge engineering, graph data modeling, and software engineering. The Graph Engineer is responsible for designing the ontology that makes cross\-domain reasoning possible, building and operating the graph construction pipeline, and ensuring the graph remains trustworthy, current, and queryable at the quality level the platform's intelligence depends on.


* Own the Octave canonical ontology — the labeled property graph (LPG) schema that unifies entities across Design, Build, Operate, and Protect product domains into a single coherent knowledge model
* Lead the ongoing development of the ontology authoring tool (the Platform Studio Data Engineering Tool), including schema parsing, LLM\-assisted canonical synthesis, and Fabric notebook generation
* Design and implement the entity resolution layer — the mechanism that reconciles cross\-product identities (e.g. Pump P\-401 in Forte 3D \= P\-401 in Sequence \= asset \#4017734 in Attune) with deterministic, stable cross\-product identifiers
* Own provenance and lineage at the graph level — ensuring every node and edge carries source attribution, freshness metadata, and conflict resolution records
* Collaborate with domain experts across product teams to extract institutional knowledge and encode it into the ontology's domain taxonomy, JTBD libraries, and relationship semantics
* Design the query surface exposed to Aria agents — graph traversal patterns, MCP tool schemas for graph access, and the semantic contract agents rely on
* Drive ontology versioning discipline: schema evolution strategy
